name: How do custom cabinets differ from stock or semi-custom options?

mainEntity.name: How do custom cabinets differ from stock or semi-custom options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets offer complete design flexibility, built precisely to your specifications for size, material, finish, and features. Stock cabinets are pre-manufactured in standard sizes and limited styles, offering the lowest cost but minimal customization. Semi-custom cabinets provide more options than stock, with some size modifications and a wider selection of finishes, but still operate within set parameters. Custom solutions are the most adaptable, allowing for truly unique designs and optimal space utilization, especially in challenging layouts or historic homes common in the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, unlike stock (pre-made) or semi-custom (limited options) cabinets.
